print(f'\"name\" in match: {\"name\" in m}')
print(f'\"John\" in match: {\"John\" in m}')
print(f'99 in match: {99 in m}')

# Test with no match
m2 = p.search('xyz', evaluate_result=False)
print(f'\\nMatch with no match: {m2}')
print(f'\"name\" in no-match result: {\"name\" in m2 if m2 else \"N/A\"}')
"
